extraTaxes.name: Impuesto especial sobre los envases de plástico no reutilizables
extraTaxes.summary: Separate plastic excise (Law 7/2022, since 01.01.2023) on non-recycled plastic in non-reusable packaging, empty or filled. Applies to manufacture, import AND intra-EU acquisition; de-minimis ≤5 kg non-recycled plastic/month; special registry + Model 592 returns. OPEN QUESTION: exact applicability to a LV e-shop shipping B2C to Spain — verify with AEAT guidance before the ES calculator module claims anything.
extraTaxes.collectedBy: Agencia Tributaria (AEAT) — not the EPR scheme

notes: Indicative Ecoembes paper rate 0.105–0.115 €/kg (compliancegate, 2025) — unverified. ECOTIC ENVASES is a third scheme option.
